title: OpenAdminOS IT policy file, version 1
description: Managed configuration that an IT department deploys as policy.json. The machine file wins over the user file, key by key. A setting the policy sets is locked unless "lock" says otherwise. OpenAdminOS reports every problem with the file and the line, and does not apply an invalid key.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

version.description: The policy format. Version 1 is the only one.

allowedProviders.description: The AI providers this device may use. Any other provider is not offered or selectable, and the app refuses it for Chat, agents and provider tests.

defaultProvider.description: The provider to use. Locked, it is the only provider. Unlocked, it applies until the admin picks another one. Must be in allowedProviders when both are set.

defaultModel.description: The model of defaultProvider, as the provider names it (for example llama3.1:8b in Ollama). Requires defaultProvider.

allowedPublicReferences.description: The public references (MCP servers in the Marketplace) this device may install and use. An empty list allows none.

appRegistration.description: Your own Entra app registration, pre-seeded for Microsoft 365 sign-in. Locked, sign-in uses only this registration.

tenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID or verified domain. Required for a single-tenant app.

skipFirstRunScan.description: Skip the first-run model scan when the policy's provider is ready, and open Chat with it.

novaVoiceModes.description: The voice modes Nova may use. Without this key both are allowed. An empty list turns Nova voice off.

novaInstructions.description: Standing instructions for Nova. Locked, they replace the admin's own instructions; otherwise they are the default until the admin writes their own. Nova's fixed safety rules always apply after them.

novaCapabilities.description: What Nova may do. false is enforced whether or not the key is locked; true is a default the admin can change unless the key is locked.

webSearch.description: Public web search in OpenAI voice sessions.

connectorSends.description: Preparing messages through connectors, always confirmed with a click. A list names the only connectors Nova may send through.

startAgents.description: Preparing agent runs, always confirmed with a click.

novaMemory.description: "off" turns Nova's notes off: none are added, and saved notes are kept but never reach a prompt.

lock.description: Setting keys the admin cannot change in the app. Without this key, every setting the file sets is locked. An empty list locks nothing.
